current.text: He comes off the bench behind starting center Jakob Poeltl and is filling a 25 to 26 minute bench role.
Experts expect him to close games and play about 24 to 27 minutes, at least three more minutes than last season. One preview projects close to 30 minutes as a super sub.
Sandro Mamukelashvili, who played a lot of backup center in Toronto, is no longer on the team, which opens minutes for him.
He is healthy entering the season after last season's thumb injury.
His usage is projected to rise from 15% to about 18%, with more time on the ball and more scoring. One expert predicts a top three Sixth Man of the Year finish.
Experts see him as a top 100 player as a baseline. He could be a top 70 to 80 player if he reaches 30 minutes.
One expert sees big upside and says he could easily average 12 points, 7 rebounds and 1.5 blocks.
He is a buzzy name and is being drafted earlier than before. In an expert auction mock he went for 9 USD.
Experts like him as an upside flyer pick. He has standalone value even for a team that has Poeltl, and one expert would consider him ahead of Poeltl.
Toronto has 15 back-to-backs this season, three of them in the playoffs.
One expert predicts 52 wins for Toronto, or 56 to 57 if Kawhi Leonard plays 75 games.

durable.text: His three-point shot is not reliable yet and is a longer-term project. He makes very few threes for a forward or center.
He is 6'7 and plays center. Toronto's rebounding and rim protection held steady or improved with him at center.
He missed a lot of time last season, including with a thumb injury.

note: Experts rank him about top 100, but the markets are low: 5 USD Yahoo value, 1.9 USD Yahoo average cost and 0 USD on ESPN. In an expert mock auction he went for 9 USD, so plan on about 5 to 9 USD for a late frontcourt piece. He is a natural fit for punt 3PM. His projected 58.9% FG%, plus steals and blocks, help any big-man build, and his 66% FT% on low volume does little damage. Early in the season, check that he plays 25 or more minutes and closes games. At 30 minutes he would be a top 70 to 80 player.
